//: The operations autonomous repository work may perform, as an ALLOWLIST.
An operation absent from this file is denied — a policy that enumerated only
what is forbidden would grant every operation nobody thought of yet.
Each operation names the authority level it needs; whether the acting lane
holds that level is decided by config/control-plane-identity.json, not here.

branch.create.constraint: A task-namespaced branch. Never main, master, or a bare name.

commit.create.constraint: On the current task branch, never on a protected branch.

branch.push.constraint: The current task branch to its own name on origin. No force, no refspec, no target selection.

pr.create.constraint: Base main, head the current task branch. Neither is caller-selectable.

pr.update.constraint: The pull request for the current task branch only.

ci.read.constraint: Read-only check, run and job state.

additionalDenied.pr.approve: A change cannot approve itself. Review is an independent judgement.

evidence.source: Stage 4 of the control-plane programme. Supersedes the unmerged #1041, which proposed this authority with no identity layer beneath it and whose merge-boundary prose is now factually wrong: it states Protect Main requires only 'CI / Required merge gate', while the live ruleset 20508177 requires three contexts.
evidence.whyAnAllowlist: #1041 enumerated forbidden git and gh invocations. A blocklist grants everything nobody thought to forbid, and the set of dangerous invocations is open-ended — a new gh flag, a new subcommand, a shell construct that reaches the same effect. This file names what is permitted; everything else is denied by absence.
evidence.whatIsNeverGranted: The refusals that matter are not in this file at all. They are ALWAYS_DENIED in scripts/control-plane/authority.mjs, in code, so that editing this record cannot remove one. A control plane whose forbidden set lives in data it can write is not constrained by it.
evidence.merge: pr.merge is never granted. Merge eligibility is computed from observed GitHub state by policy.mjs and performed only when every required context is green on the exact head; that is a separate deterministic decision, not an authority a worker holds.
